content: [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&color=black)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/bare-bones-low-on-fire) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-Profile-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&color=teal)](https://modrinth.com/user/PrincParshia) --- ## 📗 描述 這是一個針對 Bare Bones 材質包的資源包，能降低當你站在火焰上或燃燒時火焰動畫的高度。它在保持極簡美學的同時，提升了遊戲過程中的視野清晰度。非常適合那些想要乾淨、不突兀外觀，而不被過度火焰干擾的玩家。 --- | **燃燒中** | **火焰** | |---|---| | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrincParshia/Bare-Bones-Low-On-Fire/refs/heads/assets/on-fire-[java].png) | ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PrincParshia/Bare-Bones-Low-On-Fire/refs/heads/assets/fire-[java].png) | ---
